field.label: Enable TackQuote
field.comment: Turns the storefront "Request a Quote" button and quote-request calls on or off.

field.label: TackQuote API Base URL
field.comment: Default is https://api.tackquote.com/v1. Include the /v1 path, no trailing slash. Change only for a staging/custom deployment.

field.label: TackQuote API Key
field.comment:
Filled in for you by Connect with TackQuote above, or paste one: create an API key in TackQuote under Settings > Developer > API Keys with the quotes:write scope, then paste it here. Stored encrypted using Magento's crypt key.
Until a key is saved the storefront quote button stays hidden.

field.label: Verify
field.comment: Save the settings above first, then test.

field.label: Enable quote-only mode
field.comment:
Turns the whole storefront into a B2B catalog: Add to Cart and checkout are refused by the server, and shoppers request a quote instead. This is enforced in PHP, not by hiding buttons, so a crafted request cannot get around it.
Existing carts are not emptied. They can still be viewed and emptied; they simply cannot grow or be checked out, and they work normally again the moment you switch this off.
Creating orders from the Admin (Sales > Orders > Create New Order) is unaffected, and so is TackQuote turning an accepted quote into a real order. The same refusals apply to shoppers using the REST and GraphQL APIs; your admin and integration tokens are exempt.
To make only some products quote-only, leave this off and set Quote only (TackQuote) to Yes on those products.
Requires a saved API key above — without one no quote button can render, so quote-only mode stays inactive rather than leaving your storefront with no way to buy AND no way to ask.

field.label: Applies to
field.comment:
Who sees the quote-only storefront. "Guests only" is the usual B2B setup: the public gets a catalog, and customers who have signed in keep a normal cart and checkout.
"Everyone except approved wholesale accounts" keeps the cart only for a signed-in customer whose wholesale application you have approved in TackQuote (matched by the customer's email address, re-checked every 5 minutes). If TackQuote cannot be reached the customer is treated as not approved and sees the quote-only storefront. Magento does not confirm a customer's email on its own: turn on Customer Configuration > Create New Account Options > Require Emails Confirmation so nobody can sign up with an approved buyer's address.

field.label: Show "Price on request" instead of prices
field.comment: For the shoppers quote-only mode applies to, product pages and category, search and related-product tiles show "Price on request" instead of the price (and no account price or volume table). Everyone else, the cart, the admin and the quote request you receive in TackQuote keep Magento's prices. This changes what is displayed; it does not remove prices from the product data feeds, REST or GraphQL. Products that are quote-only on their own (the product's "Quote only (TackQuote)" setting) keep their price and show "Available on quote".

field.label: Customer groups
field.comment: Used only when "Applies to" is set to selected customer groups. NOT LOGGED IN is a real group here and can be selected on its own — that is equivalent to "Guests only".

group.label: B2B Display (signed-in customers)
group.comment: Shows a signed-in customer what TackQuote holds for their account, read live from TackQuote and never stored in the page cache. Display only: the cart and checkout still charge Magento's own prices. The customer's email address, the product SKU and the store currency are sent to TackQuote to look the account up.

field.label: Show account price
field.comment:
"Your account price" under the product price, with the store price struck through when the account price is lower. Shown only for a price TackQuote holds for this customer's account, and not on configurable, bundle or grouped products.
The cart does not charge this price yet: checkout still uses Magento's own price. Turn this on only if you honour the account price another way (for example by quote).

field.label: Show volume pricing table
field.comment: The customer's quantity breaks (quantity and unit price). Like the account price, these are not charged in the Magento cart yet, and are not shown on configurable, bundle or grouped products.

field.label: Show order limits notice
field.comment: "Order between X and Y units of this product." A notice only: the limit is not enforced in the Magento cart yet.

field.label: Show buyer group badge
field.comment: The name of the customer's TackQuote buyer group.

field.label: Only for these customer groups
field.comment: Leave empty to show B2B data to every signed-in customer. TackQuote finds the account by the customer's email address, and Magento does not confirm an email address a customer types at sign-up or changes later unless account confirmation is on. Selecting the groups you place approved trade customers in keeps a new account that typed someone else's address from seeing that buyer's prices. NOT LOGGED IN is never shown B2B data.

field.label: Show quote button on product pages
field.comment: When enabled, shoppers see a "Request a Quote" button on the product view page. Submitting it creates a quote request in TackQuote — it does not add to cart or affect checkout.

field.label: Show "Add to Quote" button
field.comment: Lets shoppers collect several products into a quote list and submit them as one request. The list is held in the browser and never touches the Magento cart, so stock, cart totals and checkout are unaffected.

field.label: Show on category and search results
field.comment: Adds "Add to Quote" to product listings, so a buyer can build a large request without opening every product page. Products with required options (configurable, bundle) link to the product page instead, since a quote needs the chosen variant.

group.label: Quote page, cart button and attachments
group.comment: The quote page and the cart button need "Show Add to Quote button" above.

field.label: Enable the quote page
field.comment: Adds a full page at /tackquote/quote showing the shopper's quote list, where quantities can be changed and a message added before sending, and a link to it from the quote list. No CMS page is needed.

field.label: Ask for a target price per product
Show a quote button on the cart page
field.comment: Copies the products and quantities in the shopper's cart into their quote list. The cart itself is not changed. Bundle products and products with custom options are left out and named, because a quote needs them chosen on their product page.

field.label: Allow attachments on quote requests
field.comment:
Shoppers can attach up to 3 files (PDF, JPEG or PNG, 5 MB each) to a quote request. Each file is checked by this store, then sent to TackQuote with its file name; nothing is saved in Magento.
Shown once TackQuote confirms it accepts files, checked by Magento cron every 5 minutes.
